# Career Coach

> Career Coach is a free, AI-powered career platform for Tulane University undergraduates: career-path exploration, a personalized recruiting roadmap, resume and interview prep, job search, and an AI career coach available any time. Access is limited to @tulane.edu students. Built by seven Tulane students; not an official Tulane University service.

## Who this is for

Tulane University undergraduates and recent graduates, any year or major. Not a general public product — this is not for students at other schools.

## What it costs

Free today: $0, no account, no card. See /pricing.html for what might change later.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://career-coach-site.pages.dev/): what Career Coach does, in one page
- [FAQ](https://career-coach-site.pages.dev/faq.html): what we are, who it's for, what it costs, how to start, how we compare to a career center and to LinkedIn
- [Coaching & Roadmap](https://career-coach-site.pages.dev/coaching-roadmaps.html): the personalized roadmap builder, plus a fully worked Tulane example
- [Career Toolkit](https://career-coach-site.pages.dev/career-toolkit.html): resume review, resume templates, cover letters, interview prep, job and internship search
- [AI Career Coach](https://career-coach-site.pages.dev/ai-coach.html): ask any career question, answered with Tulane-specific context
- [About](https://career-coach-site.pages.dev/about.html): who built it, why, and the team
- [Pricing](https://career-coach-site.pages.dev/pricing.html): what's free today and what might come later
